chunks: A man from the Tabi'in heard Anas ibn Malik saying: This verse was revealed regarding Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him):
"Is the one who is devoutly obedient in the hours of the night, prostrating and standing, fearing the Hereafter and hoping for the mercy of his Lord?"

The man said: So I went to Ali (peace be upon him) to observe his worship. I swear by God, I came to him at Maghrib time and found him leading his companions in Maghrib prayer. When he finished it, he sat in supplication until he stood for the final Isha prayer. Then he entered his house, and I entered with him. I found him praying and reciting the Quran throughout the entire night until dawn. Then he renewed his ablution, went out to the mosque, and led the people in Fajr prayer. Then he sat in supplication until sunrise. Then the people came to him, and two men at a time would bring their disputes before him; whenever one pair finished, another two would come, until he stood for the Dhuhr prayer. He said: Then he renewed his ablution for Dhuhr and led his companions in Dhuhr prayer. Then he sat in supplication until he led them in Asr prayer. Then the people came to him, and two men would stand while two others sat; he judged between them and gave them edicts until sunset. Then I went out saying: I swear by God that this verse was revealed regarding him.

key_terms.التابعين: Tabi'in: The generation after the Prophet's companions who met and learned from them
key_terms.التعقيب: Ta'qibat: Post-prayer supplications and invocations recited after obligatory prayers
key_terms.قانت: Qanit: Devoutly obedient, standing in worship with humility and persistence
key_terms.يختصم: Yakhtasim: To bring a dispute for arbitration before a judge

ai.seo_question: What verse of the Quran was revealed about Imam Ali's worship?
ai.summary: This narration describes an eyewitness account of Imam Ali's (AS) continuous worship and public service over a full 24-hour cycle. A man from the Tabi'in generation, upon hearing from Anas ibn Malik that Quran 39:9 was revealed about Ali, went to personally observe the Imam's devotion. He witnessed Ali leading prayers from Maghrib through the next day, spending nights in prayer and Quran recitation, and days judging disputes and issuing religious rulings for the people without rest.
